_comment: Goldens for the question-generation suite: subjects the past-questions bank
actually covers, so exemplar style transfer is exercised the way it is in
production rather than against an empty bank.
perCase is how many questions each case asks for. Kept here rather than in
code because it changes what the run costs.
threshold is versioned with the goldens on purpose — adding a harder case
should force a decision about the bar in the same commit.
thresholdNote: No tolerance. Every check here is structural — the answer key inside the options, no duplicates — and a failure means a learner can be marked wrong for a correct answer, permanently, in a competition. There is no acceptable rate of that.

cases.subject: Mathematics
cases.note: Hard maths is where a model most often writes a stem whose real answer is not among the options it wrote.

cases.subject: English Language
cases.note: Distractors here are the trap: 'metaphor' and 'simile' are both defensible for a careless stem, and a question with two right answers marks a correct learner wrong.

cases.subject: Basic Science
cases.note: A topic with a small pool of facts — the case most likely to produce duplicate stems across five questions.
